records.name: Research Ethics
records.scope_notes: Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Theoretical original articles and critical reviews allow work based on existing evidence; new clinical studies are unnecessary. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles. An AI statement is mandatory in every submission, including an explicit statement of no AI use where applicable. Preprints are accepted but must not be updated during review; accepted work requires a final-publication link. The journal-specific AI statement requirement is stricter than Sage's general assistive-editing disclosure exemption.

Articles normally have 5000–8000 words and may reach 10000 including the specified elements; longer submissions are returned for shortening. AI-generated text or visuals require full disclosure and explicit editorial permission under the journal-specific policy. Preprints are accepted; supply the DOI, keep that version unchanged during journal evaluation, and link to the final article after acceptance.
route.other_mandatory_costs: None stated for standard publication within article limits. No compulsory membership, registration, or page/overlength payment is specified in the inspected journal instructions. Optional paid services and third-party reuse permissions are separate.

fee_evidence.note: Independently checked the journal-specific fee section: submission and publication incur no fee; paid Sage Choice is optional. Author instructions state no compulsory membership or registration payment.
The journal separately requires explicit editorial permission for disclosed AI-generated text/visuals and returns overlength articles for shortening rather than listing a paid excess-length route.
Independently read journal-specific publishing-fees section: no submission or publication fees; optional Sage Choice carries a fee.

metrics.population: All submissions receiving a final accept or reject decision during the reporting year, across all article types; not an externally reviewed-only population or a cohort of manuscripts first submitted that year.
metrics.note: Directly read official dashboard on 2026-11-16. Period and denominator definition: https://www.sagepub.com/journals/understanding-journal-metrics. author_eligibility.description: Journal page encourages submissions from authors across all countries and backgrounds.

geography.scope_notes: Official journal homepage describes the subject scope; no journal base or author geographic eligibility established from this page. No author-location restriction is inferred from the journal name, scope, or publisher location.

evidence.note: Official journal homepage describes the subject scope; no journal base or author geographic eligibility established from this page.
Journal page affirmatively encourages authors across countries.

ai_policy.summary: Sage permits disclosed generated text and research assistance, including literature support and AI-generated or checked code, with human verification. It prohibits analysis of experiences and themes and generating a submission through a series of prompts.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose generated content affecting methodology, analysis, results or conclusions at submission; describe appropriate research uses in methods or acknowledgements. Language, grammar and structure suggestions alone are exempt. Verify outputs and cite original sources.

restrictions: Do not generate a submission using a series of prompts.
Do not use GenAI to analyze experiences and themes, fabricate data or references, or present generated images as novel research images.
Authors remain responsible; AI is not an author.

policy_sources.note: Journal instructions direct authors to Sage publication ethics policies; no additional AI-specific provision found in instructions.
Explicitly addresses generated text, literature assistance, research code, disclosure and prohibited uses.
